meta.title: AeroVibe — Drone spots, flight plans, and community
meta.description: Discover real spots, plan flights, and build community. AeroVibe combines map-first discovery, optimized media, hangar, and ranking into a fast experience.

hero.title: Land on real spots. Fly with confidence.
hero.subtitle: AeroVibe is the hub to discover, create, and plan drone spots with real location, optimized media, and Pro tools.
hero.note: iOS and Android. Private beta in progress.

features.title: Everything you need, no noise
features.subtitle: Built for pilots: fast, clear, and focused on what matters.

cards.map_body: Nearby spots, pins, and detail. When creating, pick a point on the map (or use GPS).
cards.media_body: Thumbnails, compression, and smooth playback for photo and video.
cards.flight_body: Schedule flights, invite copilots, and get reminders.
cards.ranking_body: Points for real activity. Badges that evolve with your progress.
cards.hangar_body: Your drones, stats, and slots based on your plan.
cards.moderation_body: Tools to keep the community safe and the signal clean.

showcase.title: AeroVibe look & feel
showcase.subtitle: Futuristic dark, lime and cyan. Also available in light.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free, upgrade when you need it.

about.title: About us
about.p1: We’re a small team obsessed with clean flights, useful data, and a no-BS community. AeroVibe was born from field hours, dead batteries, and that eternal question: “where do I fly today?”.
about.p2: We build the product as if we’ll use it every day: fast, simple, and ready to scale.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: AeroVibe processes information to operate the app (spots, profiles, media, and flight plans). This policy summarizes what we collect, how we use it, and your options.

data.title: Data we collect
bullets: Account: email, authentication identifiers, and settings.
Content: spots, descriptions, comments, and media you upload.
Location: if enabled, coordinates to create spots and improve the map.
Usage: performance metrics and diagnostics to improve stability.

sharing.title: Third parties and providers
bullets: Infrastructure and database (e.g., Supabase/Postgres) to store data.
Maps (e.g., Mapbox) to render the map.
Media storage (buckets) for photos and videos.

retention.title: Retention and security
retention.body: We apply reasonable measures to protect data. We keep information while your account is active or as needed to operate the service, unless legal obligations require otherwise.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can request access, correction, or deletion of data. If you delete your account, we’ll attempt to delete or anonymize associated information, except where required by law or to prevent abuse.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy questions, email us at {{email}}.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using AeroVibe you agree to these terms. We aim for a useful and safe community: real content, respect, and zero spam.

accounts.title: Account and access
bullets: You’re responsible for your account and credentials.
Do not attempt to access data or features without authorization.
We may suspend accounts for abuse or violations.

content.title: Content and community
bullets: Do not post illegal or dangerous content, or content that violates third-party rights.
Avoid posting sensitive coordinates if they can create risk.
We may moderate or remove content that violates policies.

pro.title: Pro plans
pro.body: Pro features may require a subscription. If you cancel, benefits may remain until the end of the paid period (depending on the payment platform).

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: AeroVibe does not replace local regulations or legal advice. Always verify flight rules, weather, and permissions before operating a drone.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: We use local storage (and, in some cases, cookies) to remember preferences and improve the experience.

optional.title: Optional
bullets: Anonymous metrics to improve performance (if enabled).

control.title: How to control them
control.body: You can clear cookies and site data from your browser settings. Some features may stop remembering your preferences.

not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.body: The link you opened doesn’t exist or was moved.
